# Every station-to-station route the v2.8.1 configuration in test/autonomy.json offers.
#
# Ground truth for the core graph.  Generated by testAutonomyGroundTruth from that file - 91 points,
# 121 edges, 44 stations, hand-authored against a railway that exists - using Layout.bfs, so this is a
# fact about the RAILWAY rather than about any train: no occupancy, no exclusions, no lengths.
#
# What it looked like when pinned, 18 August 2026:
#   1381 ordered pairs, out of a possible 1892
#   all 44 stations appear as an origin; 35 of them appear as a destination
#   389 routes run one way only - A reaches B and B does not reach A
#   each station reaches between 31 and 33 others
#
# The nine stations that are never a destination are reached but not routed TO, which is what a
# one-way approach or a staging siding looks like from here.  That is a property of the railway, not a
# fault in it.
#
# A changed line in this file is either a bug or a decision.  If it is a decision, regenerate the file
# and say why in the commit; if it is a bug, the test names the routes that appeared or vanished.
